## 2026-08-12 - Fix XSS Vulnerability in QR Code rendering
**Vulnerability:** The application was using `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` to render a QR code generated by `qrcode-generator`'s `createSvgTag()`, which creates an XSS vulnerability since the input link is embedded directly into the DOM as HTML without proper sanitization.
**Learning:** Combining third-party SVG string generators with `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` is an easy way to introduce DOM-based XSS when the string source contains user-influenced data (like a generated URL).
**Prevention:** Avoid `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` for QR codes. Generate image data URLs using `qr.createDataURL()` and render them securely via `<img src={...} />`.
